column3: CIO-22 D: the suite is 3,617 test clauses in 400 tests.lgt files, not programs; each case is one generated program that prints one verdict line, and its ref is the case's own expectation (ISO/IEC 13211-1's, as the Logtalk authors wrote it), cut from no oracle run.
